description: A lever on a stone post powering a fence gate next to it: flip the lever and the gate opens.
notes: A fence gate opens on a redstone signal and exposes `open_bit`, so the check is on the world state and not on a block rename. The piston variant from the roadmap needs the head block name verified live (Bedrock uses `sticky_piston_arm_collision`), which is still an open live check.
